---
title: "`r params$title`"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: scroll
    self_contained: true
    theme: cosmo
    mathjax: null
params:
  results_dir: "results"
  results_label: ""
  aligner: "star_salmon"
  samplesheet: "samplesheet.csv"
  contrasts: "contrasts.csv"
  fdr_de: 0.01
  fdr_splicing: 0.01
  lfc_de: 0
  dpsi_splicing: 0
  table_max_rows: 5000
  plot_max_points: 20000
  plot_ns_points: 2000
  tables_dir: ""
  tables_link: ""
  fdr_gsea: 0.05
  rmats_counts: "JC"
  heatmap_top_n: 50
  event_heatmap_per_type: 15
  event_heatmap_scale: "z"
  lookup_events_per_gene: 3
  kegg_maps: true
  kegg_top_n: 8
  kegg_cache: ""
  title: "rnaseq-splice report"
  project: ""
---

<!--
  rnaseq-splice results report
  ----------------------------
  Summarises the limma/voom differential expression (DE) and rMATS differential
  splicing (DS) results written by the rnaseq-splice pipeline (fork of nf-core/rnaseq).

  Render with report/render_report.R, or directly:
    rmarkdown::render("rnaseq_splice_report.Rmd",
                      params = list(results_dir = "results", samplesheet = "samplesheet.csv",
                                    contrasts = "contrasts.csv"))

  Significance: DE genes have limma adj.P.Val < fdr_de and |logFC| > lfc_de; DS events have rMATS
  FDR < fdr_splicing and |dPSI| > dpsi_splicing. lfc_de and dpsi_splicing default to 0 (no effect-size
  cut-off), so small but consistent changes are kept for downstream ontology analyses.

  Large results: tables in the page show at most table_max_rows rows (lowest FDR first). Volcano/MA
  plots draw every significant point (a random plot_max_points of them if there are more) and a random
  plot_ns_points of the non-significant ones. When tables_dir is set, the full
  significant gene/event tables are written there as TSV and linked from the page via tables_link.

  Sign conventions (both follow treatment vs control from contrasts.csv):
    logFC > 0  : higher expression in the treatment group
    dPSI  > 0  : higher exon inclusion in the treatment group
                 (the pipeline passes the treatment BAMs to rMATS as --b1)
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(flexdashboard)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(plotly)
    library(DT)
    library(htmltools)
})

report_dir <- normalizePath(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)))
# Knit one child page. knit_child() returns htmlwidgets as raw HTML, which pandoc would otherwise
# parse in full (several GB of memory for a multi-contrast report); marking each widget's JSON
# payload as preserved makes rmarkdown set it aside before pandoc and restore it afterwards.
knit_page <- function(file, envir = parent.frame()) {
    out <- strsplit(knitr::knit_child(file.path(report_dir, file), envir = envir, quiet = TRUE), "\n")[[1]]
    big <- grepl('^<script type="application/json"', out)
    out[big] <- paste0("<!--html_preserve-->", out[big], "<!--/html_preserve-->")
    paste(out, collapse = "\n")
}
aln_dir    <- file.path(params$results_dir, params$aligner)
fdr_de     <- as.numeric(params$fdr_de)
fdr_ds     <- as.numeric(params$fdr_splicing)
lfc_de     <- as.numeric(params$lfc_de)
dpsi_ds    <- as.numeric(params$dpsi_splicing)
max_rows   <- as.integer(params$table_max_rows)
max_points <- as.integer(params$plot_max_points)
ns_points  <- as.integer(params$plot_ns_points)

# Human-readable significance rules, used in titles and text
de_rule <- paste0("FDR < ", fdr_de, if (lfc_de > 0) paste0(", |log2FC| > ", lfc_de) else ", no fold-change cut-off")
ds_rule <- paste0("FDR < ", fdr_ds, if (dpsi_ds > 0) paste0(", |ΔPSI| > ", dpsi_ds) else ", no ΔPSI cut-off")

# Full significant tables written next to the report (when tables_dir is set)
tables_dir  <- params$tables_dir
tables_link <- params$tables_link
if (nzchar(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_full_table <- function(df, file) {
    if (!nzchar(tables_dir)) return(invisible(NULL))
    write.table(df, file.path(tables_dir, file), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
}
# Keep the page responsive: show the first max_rows rows (already sorted) and say where the rest is
capped_table <- function(df, file, ..., full_df = df) {
    write_full_table(full_df, file)
    n <- nrow(df)
    note <- if (n > max_rows) {
        htmltools::p(style = "margin: 0.3em 0.5em; color: #555;",
            sprintf("Showing the %s rows with the lowest FDR out of %s. ", format(max_rows, big.mark = ","),
                    format(n, big.mark = ",")),
            if (nzchar(tables_link)) htmltools::tagList("Full table: ",
                htmltools::a(href = file.path(tables_link, file), file)) else NULL)
    } else if (nzchar(tables_link)) {
        htmltools::p(style = "margin: 0.3em 0.5em; color: #555;", "Also saved as ",
                     htmltools::a(href = file.path(tables_link, file), file))
    }
    htmltools::tagList(note, dt_table(head(df, max_rows), file_name = sub("\\.tsv$", "", file), ...))
}
# Volcano/MA plots: every significant point (a random max_points of them if there are more) plus a
# random ns_points of the non-significant ones, which only show the shape of the background
sample_points <- function(df, is_sig) {
    n_sig <- sum(is_sig); n_ns <- sum(!is_sig)
    if (n_sig <= max_points && n_ns <= ns_points) return(list(df = df, note = ""))
    set.seed(1)
    keep_sig <- if (n_sig > max_points) sample(which(is_sig), max_points) else which(is_sig)
    keep_ns  <- if (n_ns > ns_points) sample(which(!is_sig), ns_points) else which(!is_sig)
    fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
    note <- paste0(" — ", if (n_sig > max_points) paste0("random ", fmt(max_points), " of ") else "all ",
                   fmt(n_sig), " significant",
                   if (n_ns > ns_points) paste0(" + random ", fmt(ns_points), " of ", fmt(n_ns), " non-significant") else "",
                   " shown")
    list(df = df[sort(c(keep_sig, keep_ns)), ], note = note)
}
# plotly copies a fixed hovertemplate (and mode/type) onto every point when traces come from a colour
# mapping; collapse those to single values, which makes scatter plots about 4x smaller in the HTML
compact_plotly <- function(p) {
    b <- plotly_build(p)
    b$x$data <- lapply(b$x$data, function(tr) {
        for (k in c("hovertemplate", "mode", "type", "name")) {
            v <- tr[[k]]
            if (length(v) > 1 && length(unique(unlist(v))) == 1) tr[[k]] <- unlist(v)[1]
        }
        tr
    })
    b
}

# Colours: direction (up/down), shared by DE and splicing plots
col_up   <- "#EE9A00"   # orange2: up-regulated / higher inclusion
col_down <- "#6495ED"   # cornflowerblue: down-regulated / lower inclusion
col_ns   <- "#BDBDBD"
event_types  <- c("SE", "MXE", "A3SS", "A5SS", "RI")
event_labels <- c(SE = "Skipped exon", MXE = "Mutually exclusive exons",
                  A3SS = "Alternative 3' splice site", A5SS = "Alternative 5' splice site",
                  RI = "Retained intron")
event_cols   <- c(SE = "#1B9E77", MXE = "#D95F02", A3SS = "#7570B3", A5SS = "#E7298A", RI = "#66A61E")

fmt_p <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2)

# Searchable table with CSV/Excel export of every row (not only the visible page)
dt_table <- function(df, numeric_cols = NULL, sci_cols = NULL, page_len = 15, file_name = "table") {
    dt <- DT::datatable(
        df,
        rownames   = FALSE,
        filter     = "top",
        extensions = "Buttons",
        options    = list(
            pageLength = page_len,
            scrollX    = TRUE,
            dom        = "Bfrtip",
            buttons    = list(
                list(extend = "csv",   filename = file_name, exportOptions = list(modifier = list(page = "all"))),
                list(extend = "excel", filename = file_name, exportOptions = list(modifier = list(page = "all")))
            )
        ),
        class = "compact stripe hover"
    )
    if (length(numeric_cols)) dt <- DT::formatRound(dt, numeric_cols, digits = 3)
    if (length(sci_cols))     dt <- DT::formatSignif(dt, sci_cols, digits = 3)
    dt
}

# Up/down bar chart (ggplot geom_col + theme_bw,
# scale_fill_manual(c("cornflowerblue", "orange2"))): up counts as positive orange bars, down counts
# as negative blue bars, each labelled with its absolute count; hovering shows the count too.
updown_barplot <- function(x, n_up, n_down, up_name = "Up", down_name = "Down",
                           ylab = "Number of DEGs", legend_title = "Regulation", noun = "genes") {
    x   <- factor(x, levels = unique(x))
    lim <- max(c(n_up, n_down, 1)) * 1.2          # symmetric axis with room for the labels
    bw_axis <- list(showline = TRUE, mirror = TRUE, linecolor = "#333333", linewidth = 1,
                    showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#EBEBEB", zeroline = FALSE,
                    ticks = "outside", tickcolor = "#333333", tickfont = list(color = "#4D4D4D"))
    bar <- function(p, y, n, name, colour) {
        add_bars(p, x = x, y = y, name = name, marker = list(color = colour),
                 text = format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), textposition = "outside",
                 textfont = list(color = "black", size = 13), cliponaxis = FALSE, customdata = n,
                 hovertemplate = paste0("%{x}<br>%{customdata:,} ", noun, "<extra>", name, "</extra>"))
    }
    plot_ly() |>
        bar(-n_down, n_down, down_name, col_down) |>
        bar(n_up, n_up, up_name, col_up) |>
        layout(barmode = "relative", bargap = 0.1, plot_bgcolor = "white",
               xaxis = c(bw_axis, list(title = "", tickangle = -45, type = "category",
                                       categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = levels(x))),
               yaxis = c(bw_axis, list(title = ylab, range = c(-lim, lim))),
               legend = list(title = list(text = legend_title), traceorder = "normal"))
}

message_box <- function(text) {
    htmltools::div(style = "padding: 1em; color: #555; font-style: italic;", text)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

samples <- read.csv(params$samplesheet, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    distinct(sample, condition)          # technical replicates share a sample id
contrasts <- read.csv(params$contrasts, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Gene id -> gene name, from the Salmon gene count matrix written by nf-core/rnaseq
gene_names <- local({
    f <- file.path(aln_dir, "salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv")
    if (file.exists(f)) {
        read.delim(f, check.names = FALSE)[, c("gene_id", "gene_name")] |> distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
    } else {
        data.frame(gene_id = character(), gene_name = character())
    }
})

# limma/voom results, one table per contrast
read_limma <- function(ct) {
    f <- file.path(aln_dir, "limma", ct, paste0(ct, ".limma.results.tsv"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
    read.delim(f, check.names = FALSE) |>
        left_join(gene_names, by = "gene_id") |>
        mutate(
            gene_name = coalesce(gene_name, gene_id),
            FDR       = adj.P.Val,
            direction = case_when(FDR < fdr_de & abs(logFC) > lfc_de & logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
                                  FDR < fdr_de & abs(logFC) > lfc_de & logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
                                  TRUE                                           ~ "NS")
        )
}
de <- setNames(lapply(contrasts$contrast, read_limma), contrasts$contrast)
de <- de[!vapply(de, is.null, logical(1))]

# voom log-CPM of all samples (every contrast is fitted on the same matrix, so take the first)
logcpm <- local({
    f <- if (length(de)) file.path(aln_dir, "limma", names(de)[1], paste0(names(de)[1], ".normalised_counts.tsv"))
    if (length(f) && file.exists(f)) {
        m <- read.delim(f, check.names = FALSE)
        rownames(m) <- m$gene_id
        as.matrix(m[, setdiff(colnames(m), "gene_id"), drop = FALSE])
    } else NULL
})

# rMATS events, all five types, one table per contrast
psi_mean <- function(x) {
    vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), ","), function(v) {
        v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
        if (all(is.na(v))) NA_real_ else mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    }, numeric(1))
}
reads_sum <- function(x) {
    vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), ","), function(v) sum(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
}
# Genomic location of the alternative region of each event (1-based, inclusive)
event_location <- function(d, type) {
    loc <- switch(type,
        SE   = paste0(d$exonStart_0base + 1, "-", d$exonEnd),
        RI   = paste0(d$upstreamEE + 1, "-", d$downstreamES),
        MXE  = paste0(d$`1stExonStart_0base` + 1, "-", d$`1stExonEnd`, " | ",
                      d$`2ndExonStart_0base` + 1, "-", d$`2ndExonEnd`),
        A3SS = ,
        A5SS = paste0("long ", d$longExonStart_0base + 1, "-", d$longExonEnd,
                      " | short ", d$shortES + 1, "-", d$shortEE)
    )
    paste0(d$chr, ":", loc, " (", d$strand, ")")
}
read_rmats <- function(ct) {
    out <- lapply(event_types, function(type) {
        # the read-coverage filtered tables (rmats/<contrast>/filtered/, pipeline --rmats_min_reads)
        # when the pipeline wrote them, otherwise rMATS's own output
        fname <- paste0(type, ".MATS.", params$rmats_counts, ".txt")
        f <- file.path(aln_dir, "rmats", ct, "filtered", fname)
        if (!file.exists(f)) f <- file.path(aln_dir, "rmats", ct, fname)
        if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
        d <- read.delim(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
        d <- d[, !duplicated(colnames(d))]     # rMATS repeats the ID column
        # rMATS numbers events per run, so events are matched across contrasts by their coordinates
        coord_cols <- colnames(d)[seq(which(colnames(d) == "strand") + 1, which(colnames(d) == "IJC_SAMPLE_1") - 1)]
        coord_cols <- setdiff(coord_cols, "ID")
        data.frame(
            event_id     = paste0(type, "_", d$ID),
            event_key    = paste(type, d$chr, d$strand, do.call(paste, c(d[coord_cols], sep = ":")), sep = "|"),
            event_type   = type,
            gene_id      = gsub('"', "", d$GeneID),
            gene_name    = gsub('"', "", d$geneSymbol),
            location     = event_location(d, type),
            PSI_treatment = psi_mean(d$IncLevel1),
            PSI_control   = psi_mean(d$IncLevel2),
            dPSI         = d$IncLevelDifference,
            PValue       = d$PValue,
            FDR          = d$FDR,
            junction_reads = reads_sum(d$IJC_SAMPLE_1) + reads_sum(d$SJC_SAMPLE_1) +
                             reads_sum(d$IJC_SAMPLE_2) + reads_sum(d$SJC_SAMPLE_2),
            # per-sample PSI, comma separated, in samplesheet order within each condition
            # (the order the pipeline writes the rMATS bam lists in); parsed only where needed
            inc1         = as.character(d$IncLevel1),
            inc2         = as.character(d$IncLevel2),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    })
    out <- bind_rows(out)
    if (!nrow(out)) return(out)
    out |>
        mutate(
            gene_name = ifelse(is.na(gene_name) | gene_name %in% c("", "NA"), gene_id, gene_name),
            sig       = !is.na(FDR) & !is.na(dPSI) & FDR < fdr_ds & abs(dPSI) > dpsi_ds,
            direction = case_when(sig & dPSI > 0 ~ "Higher inclusion",
                                  sig & dPSI < 0 ~ "Lower inclusion",
                                  TRUE           ~ "NS")
        )
}
ds <- setNames(lapply(contrasts$contrast, read_rmats), contrasts$contrast)
rmats_filtered <- any(dir.exists(file.path(aln_dir, "rmats", contrasts$contrast, "filtered")))
has_ds <- any(vapply(ds, nrow, integer(1)) > 0)

# MultiQC general statistics (one row per sample; FastQC adds "<sample> Read 1/2" rows)
mqc <- local({
    f <- list.files(file.path(params$results_dir, "multiqc"), pattern = "^multiqc_general_stats\\.txt$",
                    recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(f)) read.delim(f[1], check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else NULL
})

# Software versions collated by the pipeline
versions <- local({
    f <- list.files(file.path(params$results_dir, "pipeline_info"), pattern = "software_mqc_versions\\.yml$",
                    full.names = TRUE)
    if (!length(f)) return(NULL)
    y <- yaml::read_yaml(f[1])
    bind_rows(lapply(names(y), function(p) {
        if (!is.list(y[[p]])) return(NULL)
        data.frame(process = p, tool = names(y[[p]]), version = vapply(y[[p]], as.character, character(1)))
    })) |> distinct(tool, version, .keep_all = TRUE) |> arrange(tolower(tool))
})

# Gene set enrichment (fgsea) results written by the pipeline's --gsea step, one folder per contrast.
# Calls are re-made here at fdr_gsea so the report can use a different cut-off than the pipeline run.
fdr_gs <- as.numeric(params$fdr_gsea)
read_gsea <- function(ct, suffix) {
    f <- file.path(aln_dir, "gsea", ct, paste0(ct, suffix))
    if (file.exists(f)) read.delim(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else NULL
}
gsea_de <- lapply(setNames(contrasts$contrast, contrasts$contrast), read_gsea, ".fgsea_de.tsv")
gsea_de <- lapply(gsea_de[!vapply(gsea_de, is.null, logical(1))], function(g) {
    g$direction <- ifelse(!is.na(g$padj) & g$padj < fdr_gs, ifelse(g$NES > 0, "Up", "Down"), "NS")
    g
})
gsea_ds <- lapply(setNames(contrasts$contrast, contrasts$contrast), read_gsea, ".fgsea_splicing.tsv")
gsea_ds <- lapply(gsea_ds[!vapply(gsea_ds, is.null, logical(1))], function(g) {
    g$significant <- !is.na(g$padj) & g$padj < fdr_gs
    g
})
has_gsea <- length(gsea_de) + length(gsea_ds) > 0
# Settings the pipeline used (latest params_*.json in pipeline_info), for the methods text
run_params <- local({
    f <- sort(list.files(file.path(params$results_dir, "pipeline_info"), pattern = "^params_.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE))
    if (length(f)) jsonlite::fromJSON(f[length(f)]) else list()
})
run_param <- function(name, default) if (!is.null(run_params[[name]])) run_params[[name]] else default
# Long gene set names do not fit on a plot axis: shorten them (the full name is in the hover text)
short_name <- function(x, n = 55) make.unique(ifelse(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n - 1), "…"), x), sep = " ")
first_genes <- function(x, n = 15) {
    vapply(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(g) {
        if (length(g) > n) paste0(paste(g[seq_len(n)], collapse = ";"), "; … (", length(g), " genes)") else paste(g, collapse = ";")
    }, character(1))
}

ct_levels   <- contrasts$contrast
sample_cond <- setNames(samples$condition, samples$sample)
cond_cols   <- setNames(
    grDevices::hcl.colors(max(3, length(unique(samples$condition))), "Dark 3")[seq_along(unique(samples$condition))],
    unique(samples$condition)
)
# Conditions in a natural order for plots: controls first, then treatments in contrasts.csv order
# (list the contrasts by increasing dose to get dose order), then anything else
cond_order <- unique(c(contrasts$control, contrasts$treatment, samples$condition))
cond_order <- cond_order[cond_order %in% samples$condition]
sample_order <- unlist(lapply(cond_order, function(cd) samples$sample[samples$condition == cd]))

# Per-sample PSI of selected events of one contrast: a matrix events x samples (control samples first).
# IncLevel1 holds the treatment samples and IncLevel2 the control samples, each in samplesheet order.
parse_psi <- function(x, n) {
    m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE), function(v) {
        v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)); length(v) <- n; v
    }))
    if (is.null(m)) matrix(NA_real_, 0, n) else m
}
event_psi <- function(ev, ct) {
    ct_row <- contrasts[contrasts$contrast == ct, ]
    s_trt  <- samples$sample[samples$condition == ct_row$treatment]
    s_ctl  <- samples$sample[samples$condition == ct_row$control]
    m <- cbind(parse_psi(ev$inc2, length(s_ctl)), parse_psi(ev$inc1, length(s_trt)))
    colnames(m) <- c(s_ctl, s_trt)
    rownames(m) <- ev$event_id
    m
}
# Short readable label of an event: gene, type and the first region of its location (full location in hovers)
event_label <- function(ev) {
    loc <- sub(" \\|.*$", "", sub(" \\([+-]\\)$", "", ev$location))
    paste0(ev$gene_name, " · ", ev$event_type, " ", sub(":long ", ":", loc))
}

# Row z-scores; rows without variation become 0
row_z <- function(m) {
    z <- t(scale(t(m)))
    z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
    z
}
# Diverging colour scale (blue - white - orange) shared by heatmaps
div_cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(col_down, "white", col_up))(101)

# Heatmap with rows clustered by Euclidean distance (complete linkage), as on the Across contrasts
# page: dendrogram on the left, row labels on the right.
#   zc: matrix the rows are clustered on (NA counts as 0); zs: matrix shown (default zc)
#   text: hover text matrix (same shape as zc), x: column labels, ylab: row labels
#   show_x: draw the column labels (FALSE for all but the bottom panel of a stack)
# Returns the plotly object and the row order, so callers can reorder their own annotations.
cluster_heatmap <- function(zc, x, ylab, text, zs = zc, colors = div_cols, zmin = -2.5, zmax = 2.5,
                            showscale = TRUE, colorbar = list(title = "z"), show_x = TRUE,
                            dendro_width = 0.15) {
    filled <- zc; filled[!is.finite(filled)] <- 0
    hc  <- if (nrow(zc) > 2) hclust(dist(filled, method = "euclidean"), method = "complete") else NULL
    ord <- if (is.null(hc)) seq_len(nrow(zc)) else hc$order
    ylab <- make.unique(ylab[ord])
    ypos <- seq_len(nrow(zc))                        # row i sits at y = i (top to bottom)
    yaxis <- list(title = "", autorange = "reversed", range = c(nrow(zc) + 0.5, 0.5),
                  showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE)
    hm <- plot_ly(x = x, y = ypos, z = zs[ord, , drop = FALSE], text = text[ord, , drop = FALSE],
                  type = "heatmap", colors = colors, zmin = zmin, zmax = zmax, showscale = showscale,
                  colorbar = colorbar, hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>") |>
        layout(xaxis = list(title = "", type = "category", tickangle = -45, showticklabels = show_x),
               yaxis = c(yaxis, list(side = "right", tickmode = "array", tickvals = ypos, ticktext = ylab,
                                     tickfont = list(size = 10))))
    if (is.null(hc)) return(list(plot = hm, order = ord))
    # dendrogram segments from the hclust merges: leaves at height 0, root on the left
    leaf_y <- integer(length(ord)); leaf_y[ord] <- ypos
    node_y <- numeric(nrow(hc$merge)); sx <- sy <- c()
    child <- function(k) if (k < 0) c(leaf_y[-k], 0) else c(node_y[k], hc$height[k])
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(hc$merge))) {
        a <- child(hc$merge[i, 1]); b <- child(hc$merge[i, 2]); h <- hc$height[i]
        node_y[i] <- (a[1] + b[1]) / 2
        sx <- c(sx, a[2], h, h, b[2], NA); sy <- c(sy, a[1], a[1], b[1], b[1], NA)
    }
    dg <- plot_ly(x = sx, y = sy, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", line = list(color = "#555555", width = 1),
                  hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE) |>
        layout(xaxis = list(title = if (show_x) "Euclidean distance" else "", autorange = "reversed",
                            showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, showticklabels = show_x,
                            titlefont = list(size = 10), tickfont = list(size = 9)),
               yaxis = c(yaxis, list(showticklabels = FALSE)))
    list(plot = subplot(dg, hm, widths = c(dendro_width, 1 - dendro_width), shareY = FALSE, titleX = TRUE,
                        margin = 0.005),
         order = ord)
}
```

QC

```{r qc-data}
qc <- NULL
if (!is.null(mqc)) {
    pick <- function(col) if (col %in% colnames(mqc)) mqc[[col]] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(mqc))
    qc <- data.frame(
        sample             = mqc$Sample,
        # MultiQC general statistics store STAR read counts in millions
        total_reads        = round(pick("star-total_reads") * 1e6),
        uniquely_mapped    = round(pick("star-uniquely_mapped") * 1e6),
        uniquely_mapped_pc = pick("star-uniquely_mapped_percent"),
        multimapped        = round(pick("star-multimapped") * 1e6),
        salmon_mapped_pc   = pick("salmon-percent_mapped"),
        duplication_pc     = pick("picard_mark_duplicates-PERCENT_DUPLICATION")
    ) |> filter(sample %in% samples$sample)
    qc$condition <- sample_cond[qc$sample]
    qc <- qc[order(qc$condition, qc$sample), ]
}
```

        transmute(sample, condition,
                  `Uniquely mapped` = uniquely_mapped,
                  `Multi-mapped`    = multimapped,

        pivot_longer(-c(sample, condition), names_to = "category", values_to = "reads") |>
        mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = qc$sample),

    plot_ly(long, x = ~sample, y = ~reads, color = ~category, type = "bar",
            colors = c("#D9D9D9", "#9ECAE1", "#3182BD"),
            hovertemplate = "%{x}<br>%{y:,.0f} reads<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>") |>

Sample structure
=====================================

```{r pca-data}
pca <- NULL
if (!is.null(logcpm) && ncol(logcpm) >= 3) {
    v   <- apply(logcpm, 1, var)
    top <- logcpm[order(v, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(500, nrow(logcpm)))], , drop = FALSE]
    pc  <- prcomp(t(top), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
    var_exp <- 100 * pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2)
    pca <- data.frame(sample = rownames(pc$x), pc$x[, 1:min(3, ncol(pc$x)), drop = FALSE])
    pca$condition <- sample_cond[pca$sample]
}
```

ds_counts <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ds), function(ct) {
    d <- ds[[ct]]
    if (!nrow(d)) return(data.frame(contrast = ct, event_type = event_types, tested = 0L,
                                    `Higher inclusion` = 0L, `Lower inclusion` = 0L, check.names = FALSE))
    d |> mutate(event_type = factor(event_type, levels = event_types)) |>

        summarise(tested = sum(!is.na(FDR)),
                  `Higher inclusion` = sum(direction == "Higher inclusion"),
                  `Lower inclusion`  = sum(direction == "Lower inclusion"), .groups = "drop") |>
        mutate(contrast = ct, event_type = as.character(event_type))
})) |> select(contrast, event_type, everything())

DE × splicing
=====================================

```{r overlap-data}
overlap_counts <- bind_rows(lapply(contrasts$contrast, function(ct) {
    de_g <- if (ct %in% names(de)) de_sets[[ct]] else character()
    ds_g <- ds_genes[[ct]]
    data.frame(contrast = ct, `DE only` = length(setdiff(de_g, ds_g)), `Both` = length(intersect(de_g, ds_g)),
               `DS only` = length(setdiff(ds_g, de_g)), check.names = FALSE)
}))
overlap_genes <- bind_rows(lapply(contrasts$contrast, function(ct) {
    if (!ct %in% names(de) || !nrow(ds[[ct]])) return(NULL)
    both <- intersect(de_sets[[ct]], ds_genes[[ct]])
    if (!length(both)) return(NULL)
    ev <- ds[[ct]] |> filter(gene_id %in% both, direction != "NS") |>
        group_by(gene_id) |>
        summarise(sig_events = n(),
                  event_types = paste(sort(unique(event_type)), collapse = ", "),
                  dPSI_largest = dPSI[which.max(abs(dPSI))],   # signed dPSI of the event with the largest |dPSI|
                  min_event_FDR = min(FDR), .groups = "drop")
    de[[ct]] |> filter(gene_id %in% both) |>
        select(gene_id, gene_name, logFC, DE_FDR = FDR) |>
        left_join(ev, by = "gene_id") |>
        mutate(contrast = ct) |>
        select(contrast, everything())
}))
```

```{r kegg-data}
# KEGG pathway maps (kegg_overlay.R, reworked from Matt's pathview.R) for the significant gene sets of
# MSigDB's KEGG collection: expression maps coloured by log2FC of DE genes, splicing maps by the
# lead-event ΔPSI of genes with a significant event
kegg_top_n <- as.integer(params$kegg_top_n)
kegg_cache <- if (nzchar(params$kegg_cache)) params$kegg_cache else file.path(tools::R_user_dir("rnaseq-splice", "cache"), "kegg")
kegg_ids   <- read.delim(file.path(report_dir, "kegg_legacy_ids.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
kegg_maps  <- list()
has_kegg <- isTRUE(as.logical(params$kegg_maps)) && has_gsea && nzchar(tables_dir) &&   # maps are files next to the report
    any(c(unlist(lapply(gsea_de, function(g) g$pathway[g$direction != "NS"])),
          unlist(lapply(gsea_ds, function(g) g$pathway[g$significant]))) %in% kegg_ids$gene_set)
if (has_kegg) {
    source(file.path(report_dir, "kegg_overlay.R"))
    kegg_out <- file.path(if (nzchar(tables_dir)) tables_dir else tempdir(), "kegg")
    dir.create(kegg_out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    # strongest value per Entrez id
    to_entrez <- function(gene_id, value) {
        e <- ensembl_to_entrez(gene_id)
        v <- setNames(value, e)[!is.na(e) & !is.na(value)]
        v <- v[order(-abs(v))]
        v[!duplicated(names(v))]
    }
    nice_limit <- function(x, step, floor_at) {
        if (!length(x) || all(is.na(x))) return(floor_at)
        max(floor_at, ceiling(max(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE) / step) * step)
    }
    for (ct in ct_levels) {
        maps <- list(); missing <- character()
        draw <- function(analysis, set, values, limit, key, caption) {
            id  <- kegg_ids$kegg_id[match(set, kegg_ids$gene_set)]
            out <- file.path(kegg_out, paste0(ct, "_", tolower(analysis), "_", id, ".png"))
            title <- paste0(set, " (", id, "), ", ct, ": ", caption)
            n <- kegg_map_png(values, id, kegg_cache, out, title = title, limit = limit, key_label = key)
            if (is.null(n)) { missing <<- c(missing, id); return(NULL) }
            data.frame(contrast = ct, analysis = analysis, pathway = set, kegg_id = id, file = basename(out),
                       caption = paste0(caption, "; ", n[["with_value"]], " of ", n[["genes"]], " genes on the map coloured"))
        }
        # expression: significant KEGG sets from preranked GSEA
        g <- gsea_de[[ct]]
        if (!is.null(g) && ct %in% names(de)) {
            sets <- g |> filter(direction != "NS", pathway %in% kegg_ids$gene_set) |> arrange(padj, desc(abs(NES))) |> head(kegg_top_n)
            if (nrow(sets)) {
                d <- de[[ct]] |> filter(direction != "NS")
                v <- to_entrez(d$gene_id, d$logFC)
                # colour scale per map: 98th percentile of |log2FC| of the map's DE genes, rounded up to 0.5
                lim <- function(x) nice_limit(quantile(abs(x), 0.98, names = FALSE), 0.5, 1)
                for (i in seq_len(nrow(sets))) {
                    maps[[length(maps) + 1]] <- draw("Expression", sets$pathway[i], v, lim, "log2FC",
                        sprintf("%s, NES %.2f, FDR %s", sets$direction[i], sets$NES[i], fmt_p(sets$padj[i])))
                }
            }
        }
        # splicing: KEGG sets over-represented among higher- and/or lower-inclusion genes
        g <- gsea_ds[[ct]]
        if (!is.null(g) && nrow(ds[[ct]])) {
            sets <- g |> filter(significant, pathway %in% kegg_ids$gene_set) |>
                group_by(pathway) |>
                summarise(best = min(padj), lists = paste(paste0(gene_list, " FDR ", fmt_p(padj)), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") |>
                arrange(best) |> head(kegg_top_n)
            if (nrow(sets)) {
                lead <- ds[[ct]] |> filter(direction != "NS") |> arrange(gene_id, desc(abs(dPSI))) |> distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
                v <- to_entrez(lead$gene_id, lead$dPSI)
                # colour scale per map: 98th percentile of |ΔPSI| of the map's spliced genes, rounded up to 0.1
                lim <- function(x) min(1, nice_limit(quantile(abs(x), 0.98, names = FALSE), 0.1, 0.2))
                for (i in seq_len(nrow(sets))) {
                    maps[[length(maps) + 1]] <- draw("Splicing", sets$pathway[i], v, lim, "dPSI",   # the PNG font has no Δ
                        paste0("over-represented among ", sets$lists[i]))
                }
            }
        }
        kegg_maps[[ct]] <- list(maps = bind_rows(maps), missing = unique(missing))
        if (is.null(kegg_maps[[ct]]$maps) || !ncol(kegg_maps[[ct]]$maps))
            kegg_maps[[ct]]$maps <- data.frame(contrast = character(), analysis = character(), pathway = character(),
                                               kegg_id = character(), file = character(), caption = character())
    }
}
```

### Methods

```{r}
ver <- function(tool) {
    if (is.null(versions)) return("")
    v <- versions$version[tolower(versions$tool) == tolower(tool)]
    if (length(v)) paste0(" ", v[1]) else ""
}
htmltools::tagList(
    tags$p("Reads were processed with ", tags$b("rnaseq-splice"),
           ", a fork of nf-core/rnaseq that adds limma/voom differential expression and rMATS ",
           "differential splicing. Reads were trimmed with Trim Galore", ver("trimgalore"),
           ", aligned to the genome with STAR", ver("star"), " and quantified with Salmon", ver("salmon"),
           " in alignment mode; duplicates were marked (not removed) with Picard", ver("picard"), "."),
    tags$p(tags$b("Differential expression. "),
           "Length-scaled gene counts (tximport) were filtered to genes with at least the configured minimum count ",
           "in as many samples as the smallest condition group, then normalised with TMM and modelled with ",
           "limma/voom (design ~ 0 + condition, one fit across all samples, one contrast per comparison). ",
           "Genes with Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted p-value < ", fdr_de,
           if (lfc_de > 0) paste0(" and |log2 fold change| > ", lfc_de) else "",
           " are reported as differentially expressed",
           if (lfc_de > 0) "." else "; no fold-change cut-off is applied."),
    tags$p(tags$b("Differential splicing. "),
           "rMATS", ver("rmats"), " was run per contrast on the duplicate-marked genome BAMs, with the treatment ",
           "samples as group 1 and the control samples as group 2. Results use ",
           if (params$rmats_counts == "JC") "junction counts only (JC)" else "junction and exon-body counts (JCEC)",
           ". ",
           if (rmats_filtered) paste0("Events were kept only if every sample had at least ", run_param("rmats_min_reads", 10),
               " junction reads supporting the inclusion or skipping isoform, and the Benjamini–Hochberg FDR was ",
               "recomputed over the kept events. ") else "",
           "Events with FDR < ", fdr_ds, if (dpsi_ds > 0) paste0(" and |ΔPSI| > ", dpsi_ds) else "",
           " are reported as differentially spliced", if (dpsi_ds > 0) ". " else "; no ΔPSI cut-off is applied. ",
           "ΔPSI = PSI(treatment) − PSI(control). A gene is counted as differentially spliced when at least one ",
           "of its events is significant."),
    if (has_gsea) tags$p(tags$b("Gene set enrichment. "),
           "Gene sets were tested with fgsea", ver("fgsea"), " against ",
           paste(sort(unique(c(unlist(lapply(gsea_de, `[[`, "collection")), unlist(lapply(gsea_ds, `[[`, "collection"))))),
                 collapse = ", "),
           " (sets of ", run_param("gsea_min_size", 10), "–", run_param("gsea_max_size", 500), " genes). ",
           "Expression: preranked GSEA (multilevel) of all tested genes ranked by the limma ",
           if (run_param("gsea_rank_by", "t") == "t") "moderated t-statistic" else "log2 fold change",
           ", after mapping Ensembl ids to gene symbols (one id per symbol, the one with the largest |statistic|); ",
           "gene sets with BH-adjusted p < ", fdr_gs, " are Up (NES > 0) or Down (NES < 0). ",
           "Splicing: over-representation analysis (fgsea::fora, hypergeometric test, BH-adjusted) of the genes with ",
           "at least one significant rMATS event (FDR < ", run_param("gsea_splicing_fdr", 0.01),
           if (as.numeric(run_param("gsea_splicing_dpsi", 0)) > 0) paste0(", |ΔPSI| > ", run_param("gsea_splicing_dpsi", 0)) else "",
           "), separately for events with higher and with lower inclusion in the treatment group; the background is ",
           "every gene with a tested rMATS event. Gene sets with BH-adjusted p < ", fdr_gs, " are reported as enriched.")
)
```

if (is.null(versions)) {
    message_box("software_mqc_versions.yml was not found in pipeline_info/.")
} else {
    dt_table(versions, file_name = "software_versions", page_len = 25)
}

# Free the result tables before pandoc packs the self-contained HTML (pandoc needs several GB for a
# large report, and runs in the same R session's memory budget)
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "params"))
invisible(gc())
